raceIntelligence.headline: Verstappen Retains Singapore Sprint Pole After Stewards Decline Penalty
raceIntelligence.summary: Stewards found Verstappen breached a yellow-flag overtaking rule but imposed no penalty. His 1:31.156 retains Singapore Sprint pole ahead of Russell and Leclerc; Antonelli starts seventh and leads Russell by 84 points.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 01
watchPoints.title: Verstappen keeps Singapore Sprint pole
watchPoints.summary: Stewards found a yellow-flag overtake infringement in SQ1 but imposed no penalty. Verstappen retains P1, Russell P2 and Leclerc P3.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 02
watchPoints.title: Russell starts Sprint P2, Sunday race from the rear
watchPoints.summary: Russell qualified second for the Sprint. His separate power-unit penalty applies to Sunday’s Grand Prix, not Saturday’s Sprint.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 03
watchPoints.title: Mercedes package comparison still inconclusive
watchPoints.summary: Russell led FP1 in the older aero specification; Antonelli ran the newer package. Different practice tyres prevent a clean comparison.

articles.title: Verstappen Retains Singapore Sprint Pole After Stewards Decline Penalty
articles.summary: Verstappen keeps Singapore Sprint pole after stewards find a yellow-flag overtake infringement but impose no penalty. Russell starts second, Leclerc third.

articles.title: Mercedes Splits Car Specifications as Russell Faces Further Engine Trouble
articles.summary: Russell returns to the Baku-winning aero package while Antonelli retains the newer specification and a new front wing. Russell starts Sunday's Grand Prix from the rear.

articles.title: Antonelli Takes an 84-Point Lead Into Marina Bay
articles.summary: Singapore's Sprint format gives the field only one practice session before competitive running, with Antonelli 84 points clear of Russell.

articles.title: Verstappen Wins Rain-Hit Sepang Race as Antonelli Extends Championship Lead
articles.summary: Verstappen delivered Red Bull's first 2026 Grand Prix win, Antonelli finished second, Hamilton third and Russell retired late.

articles.title: Verstappen Takes Sepang Pole as Hamilton Sets Up Sunday Showdown
articles.summary: Verstappen took his first pole of 2026 ahead of Hamilton, with penalties reshaping the grid behind them.

articles.title: Sepang Circuit Intelligence: Tyres, Strategy and Weather
articles.summary: Pirelli's C2/C3/C4 allocation, abrasive asphalt, tropical heat and rain risk framed Formula 1's return to Sepang.
